metadata.source: G. Jansonas, R. Budriūnas, M. Vengris, A. Varanavičius. Interferometric measurements of nonlinear refractive index in the infrared spectral range. Opt. Express 30, 30507–30524 (2022) (https://doi.org/10.1364/OE.458850); downloaded from refractiveindex.info
metadata.description: Single crystal GaSe (o). Polar angle (θ): 0°. Electric field was parallel to the X dielectric axis. 170 fs and 190 fs at 2.2 μm and 3.2 μm, respectively. Estimated Kerr values were 35.2e-19 m2/W and 34.7e-19 m2/W at 2.2 μm and 3.2 μm, respectively.  Fourier Interferometry.
